corrected_code:
from rest_framework import viewsets, permissions, status
from rest_framework.decorators import action
from rest_framework.response import Response
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from customers.models import ClientTenant

User = get_user_model()

class TenantMembershipViewSet(viewsets.ViewSet):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    @action(detail=False, methods=['delete'])
    def remove_member(self, request):
        tenant_id = request.data.get('tenant_id')
        user_id = request.data.get('user_id')

        tenant = get_object_or_404(
            ClientTenant,
            id=tenant_id,
            user_links__user=request.user,
            user_links__is_admin=True
        )
        target_user = get_object_or_404(User, id=user_id)

        tenant.remove_user(target_user)
        return Response({'status': 'removed', 'tenant_id': tenant_id, 'user_id': user_id})
